actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA/CNV identity evidence (metabolic down-regulation with chr20q gain and PTEN/CDKN2A loss) and compatible cross-modal structure with positive boundary separation. A scanner-model association is a partial concern but does not align with the RNA/CNV-defined biology, so it is not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has a strong coherent copy-number-quiet identity (low FGA, absence of CDKN2A/JAK2/chr9p loss, chr20q gain) with stable cross-modal structure (ARI 0.84) and positive boundaries, and no set-level technical confounder. It is defensible for downstream validation.

C0003 has very strong coherent RNA identity (oxidative phosphorylation up, immune pathways down) with a distinctive retained-3p/VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 CNV pattern and positive boundaries. The small n and high degenerate resample fraction are limitations but do not undermine the defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 has no significant RNA or CNV findings, its internal structure is CT-dominated, and it carries multiple significant technical associations (site, manufacturer, reconstruction kernel) that plausibly explain its separation. The candidate is insufficiently defensible and no structural revision resolves this.

C0005 lacks significant biological signal in RNA or CNV, shows weak internal structure (ARI 0.43, PAC 0.58) with no strong modality support, and has no coherent identity. It is insufficiently defensible for retention.

C0006 has weak but directionally coherent CNV evidence (chr2p/chr2q gain) with RNA/CNV modality support and no technical confounder. Identity and structure are uncertain due to small n and high PAC, but the candidate remains plausible and no better-supported revision is indicated.

C0007 has a coherent immune/inflammatory RNA signature (interferon, IL6/JAK/STAT3, complement up) with WSI/RNA cross-modal support and positive boundaries. A site association is a partial concern but does not align with the RNA-defined biology, so it is not decision-critical for retention.

C0008 has no significant RNA or CNV findings, internal structure is not estimable (singleton child), and it is the smallest set (n=4). The candidate lacks a defensible biological identity and cannot be retained.
